title: Duplicating a texture may lead to double file that can crash the editor
body: ### Tested versions 4.7.2 v4.8.dev.custom_build [39216f0c8] ### System information openSUSE Tumbleweed 20260919 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (2560x1600 @ 165.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics (RADV STRIX_HALO) - AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 392 w/ Radeon 8060S (24 threads) - 61.94 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Sometimes duplicating a file creates two entries in FileSystem: Trying to rename or delete the duplicate entries results in a crash: ``` handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build (39216f0c8da37d877241775ab35ad2cc5e3b837c) Dumping the backtrace. I also never had it happen on Windows, so this might be platform-specific. However it's very random, so I don't know what causes it yet. EDIT: Seems similar to #109372 ### Steps to reproduce 1.
